answer: Beacon-bound commit-reveal audits. Each identity posts a 2-unit copper escrow and hashes its work log before any audit target is known. The violet audit batch opens only after a beacon signal at height H+10 selects 5% of identities for reveal. Steps: commit, beacon reveals selectors, chosen nodes reveal logs; a mismatch forfeits the escrow and bans the node for 20 epochs. An attacker running 100 identities locks 200 units; 5% sampling exposes 5 forged reveals per epoch, each burning 2 units, so fraud costs 10 per epoch while honest escrow returns whole.
